40bcaede19a07406.description: الهدف الوظيفي مسؤول عن إدارة وتشغيل وصيانة البنية التحتية التقنية للشركة، بما يشمل الخوادم وأنظمة التشغيل والشبكات والاتصالات، وضمان استمرارية الخدمات التقنية وكفاءتها وأمنها، وتقديم الدعم الفني لمختلف الإدارات والفروع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية 1. إدارة الأنظمة والخوادم إدارة وصيانة Windows Server وLinux. إدارة Active Directory وحسابات المستخدمين والصلاحيات. مراقبة أداء الخوادم ومعالجة الأعطال. إدارة بيئات VMware وHyper-V. 2. إدارة الشبكات والبنية التحتية تشغيل وإدارة شبكات LAN وWAN وWLAN. إعداد وإدارة أجهزة الشبكات مثل Switches وRouters. إدارة VLAN وVPN وFirewall. ضمان استقرار الاتصال بين الفروع والمقر الرئيسي. 3. الأمن السيبراني وحماية الأنظمة تطبيق سياسات أمن المعلومات على الأنظمة والشبكات. متابعة التحديثات الأمنية ومعالجة الثغرات. إدارة صلاحيات الوصول وحماية بيانات الشركة. مراقبة الأنشطة غير الاعتيادية والتعامل مع الحوادث التقنية. 4. النسخ الاحتياطي واستمرارية الأعمال تنفيذ ومتابعة النسخ الاحتياطي للبيانات والأنظمة. اختبار عمليات استعادة البيانات. المساهمة في خطط التعافي من الكوارث (Disaster Recovery). 5. الدعم الفني والتشغيل معالجة المشكلات التقنية المتعلقة بالشبكات والأنظمة. تقديم الدعم الفني للموظفين والفروع. متابعة الموردين ومزودي خدمات الاتصالات والتقنية. توثيق البنية التحتية والإجراءات التقنية وإعداد التقارير. المؤهلات العلمية بكالوريوس في تقنية المعلومات أو علوم الحاسب أو هندسة الشبكات أو تخصص ذي صلة. يفضل وجود شهادات مهنية متخصصة. الخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية من 3 إلى 5 سنوات في إدارة الأنظمة والشبكات. خبرة في إدارة البنية التحتية التقنية للشركات. يفضل وجود خبرة في الشركات متعددة الفروع وقطاع التجزئة.

40d866f22b2ba36b.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team for an upcoming full-time opportunity in Saudi Arabia. This role focuses on mechanical engineering expertise, particularly within Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. The position is based in the Eastern Region, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Buqayq, and Ras Tannurah. Key Responsibilities Lead and execute mechanical maintenance activities during Shutdown / Turnaround projects. Oversee the planning, execution, and coordination of shutdown activities. Manage and maintain various mechanical static equipment, including heat exchangers, columns, pressure vessels, reactors, and pipelines. Utilize Primavera P6 for project scheduling and management. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in Mechanical Maintenance or Shutdown / Turnaround projects. Mandatory experience in Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects, preferably gained with a contractor. Strong experience with mechanical static equipment, specifically: Heat Exchangers Columns Pressure Vessels Reactors Pipelines Proficiency in Primavera P6 is required. Good English communication skills are essential. Application Requirements Candidates must clearly detail their relevant experience in their CV, supported by verifiable experience certificates or letters. Only applicants with genuine and verifiable Shutdown / Turnaround experience will be considered for this position. Compensation The salary for this full-time role ranges from SAR 4,000 to SAR 7,000 Basic, plus FAT.

4006f3d1d5ce45c1.description: About the Role Musco Lighting is seeking a Production Planning Coordinator to join our team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role is essential for ensuring timely production completion through effective planning and coordination with various teams. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to develop and manage production plans, ensuring seamless coordination with internal teams to meet project deadlines. The coordinator acts as a critical link between manufacturing and sales, facilitating clear and timely communication regarding project status and requirements. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with the team to ensure projects are delivered on schedule. Serve as the information conduit for projects between manufacturing and sales, ensuring effective and timely communication. Maintain comprehensive records of all project-related information and communications within the company's system. Establish and update the Monthly Production Plan, distributing it to relevant departments as needed. Monitor the fulfillment of the Monthly Production Plan to ensure proper execution. Manage the acceptance of Production Documents and gather essential project information, including aiming diagrams, order summaries, and part listings by job range. Conduct Project Review/Production Document Review upon release of Production Documents and transfer relevant Controlled Documents to floor personnel. Track daily productivity and assess production efficiency. Undertake other duties as assigned by the company. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in production planning or a related coordination role. Demonstrated ability to manage and track project information effectively. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Work Environment and Type This is a full-time position based in Dammam, within the Eastern Region. The role involves working closely with manufacturing, sales, and other internal teams to achieve production goals. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

400913269ab009f5.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise offering end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery for built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR as a Top 225 International Design Firm and a Top 20 International PM/CM Firm, and by World Architecture as the 57th largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2023 WA100 Survey. The Role of Procurement Manager KEO International Consultants is seeking a Procurement Manager with extensive experience in the construction sector. This full-time position is based in Medina, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on large-scale hospitality projects, including hotels and mixed-use developments. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of experience, with a preference for candidates possessing 20 years in procurement and supply chain within construction, particularly in hotel projects. Key Responsibilities Manage extensive procurement and supply chain activities for large-scale hospitality, high-rise, mixed-use, and infrastructure developments across KSA and the Middle East. Lead procurement teams and manage procurement schedules, tendering activities, and supplier performance across multiple packages and work fronts. Develop procurement strategies, procurement plans, long-lead item schedules, and material delivery programs aligned with project requirements. Manage RFQs, tender evaluations, commercial comparisons, negotiations, purchase orders, and subcontract procurement activities. Source and prequalify local and international suppliers, manufacturers, subcontractors, and specialist vendors. Oversee the procurement of major construction materials, equipment, specialist systems, finishes, FF&E, and long-lead items. Conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations, implement value engineering and cost optimization initiatives, and negotiate favorable supplier terms. Coordinate with Design, Engineering, Construction, Commercial, Planning, and Project Management teams to ensure timely procurement and delivery. Monitor procurement status, manufacturing progress, inspections, shipping, customs clearance, logistics, and final delivery to site. Manage material submittals, vendor documentation, technical approvals, samples, and other procurement-related records. Review contract terms, purchase conditions, warranties, guarantees, payment terms, variations, and supplier claims. Identify procurement risks, supply chain constraints, and potential delivery delays, while implementing mitigation measures to protect project schedules. Monitor supplier performance, expedite deliveries, ensure quality compliance, and resolve procurement-related issues. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 20 years of experience in procurement and supply chain within construction projects, with a preference for hotel projects. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Mandatory experience in hospitality and mixed-use building projects. Professional certifications such as CPP, CPPM, CISCP, CISCM, or equivalent are highly desirable. Strong expertise in contract management, negotiation, and supplier management. Proven experience in developing procurement strategies and managing large-scale operations. Proficiency in procurement systems, ERP tools, and Aconex is an advantage. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Work Environment and Benefits KEO offers a supportive environment that fosters professional development through internal global mobility and career advancement. The company culture supports health and well-being through on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees are invited to participate in community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups. In addition to a competitive package, benefits include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards, mentoring and coaching programs, and extensive in-house on-demand learning courses.

405fc35bede8641e.description: 1. Role Purpose The Product & Technical Expert (PTE) leads and manages the product and technical tasks of the Agentic AI in Contact Center project across its three components — the virtual AI bot / conversational IVR, the agent-assist, and interaction analytics. The role spans requirements and vendor selection through solution design, integration, AI governance, and delivery oversight, while building lasting in-house capability through knowledge transfer to a nominated internal candidate. 2. Key Responsibilities · Manage and refine the business and technical requirements across the three components (virtual AI bot / conversational IVR, the agent-assist, and interaction analytics), and maintain the requirements and compliance matrices. · Build and maintain the use-cases and intent-prioritization backlog (Tier 1 automated, Tier 2 AI-assisted, Tier 3 human), translating call-driver data into an automation roadmap. · Define KPIs and success/acceptance criteria. · Support RFP issuance, run the technical evaluation of bidders, lead proofs-of-concept (including Saudi-dialect quality testing), and make sourcing recommendations. · Manage the implementation partner technically — scope, statement of work, deliverables, and quality. · Manage the conversational and agentic design: open intent capture, dialog flows, prompts, tone/persona, escalation triggers, and warm-handoff behavior. · Manage the design of RAG grounding approach, knowledge-base structure, and guardrail configuration. · Define the target architecture and external/internal integration design across core banking (T24), CRM (MS Dynamics), Cortex, e-channels,OTP, and the Cisco IVR/ACD and speech-recording stack. · Specify APIs, real-time context retrieval, latency targets, and the model-hosting approach. · Advise on model selection (LLM/SLM and routing), RAG, hallucination mitigation, confidence thresholds, and prompt/version management. · Establish the AI governance and guardrail framework aligned to SAMA and PDPL — human-in-the-loop for sensitive flows, audit trail, data residency, and PII redaction. · Work with Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Information Security to secure the necessary approvals. · Manage SIT, UAT, and phased go-live; manage risks, issues, and dependencies. · Stand up the analytics / AI-ops monitoring and reporting, and run the post-go-live. · Coach and up-skill the nominated internal candidate (prospective AI-Ops Lead) and the wider team; produce runbooks and operational handover. Experience:10–12 years. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

4092d5c9e77efb8e.job_title: Site Project Manager - Civil / Residential Projects
4092d5c9e77efb8e.description: Alomar Holding Company is a leading Saudi-based diversified holding group specializing in real estate development and property management. As part of our ongoing growth in Riyadh, we are seeking a Site Project Manager to oversee the execution of residential construction projects, ensuring delivery to the highest standards. This role is pivotal in managing all aspects of site operations, from early construction phases through handover and closeout. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and within budget. Key responsibilities include: Managing daily on-site execution of residential construction projects from initiation to final delivery and closeout. Leading and supervising site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and labor to ensure smooth operations. Coordinating civil, structural, architectural, finishing, fit-out, and MEP interface activities. Collaborating with consultants and client representatives, overseeing inspections, approvals, RFIs, NCRs, and site instructions. Controlling progress, quality, safety, procurement, and documentation to meet approved specifications, budget, and schedule. Reviewing and managing drawings, specifications, BOQs, schedules, method statements, material submittals, and inspection requests. Preparing progress reports, lookahead schedules, site updates, and management reports; identifying delays and implementing recovery plans. Supporting payment applications, quantity verification, variation orders, and claims in coordination with QS/cost control teams. Leading snagging/de-snagging, testing/commissioning coordination, handover documentation, and closeout processes. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering 8+ years of construction/project management experience, including at least 3 years in a site leadership role such as Project Manager or Site Project Manager Extensive contractor-side residential construction experience managing projects from early construction through handover (villas, townhouses, apartments, compounds) On-site execution experience across civil, structural, architectural, and finishing/fit-out works on residential projects Strong proficiency with Primavera P6 and/or MS Project Experience managing construction execution using project schedules, lookahead planning, quality control procedures, inspection workflows, subcontractor coordination, and handover processes Experience coordinating MEP interface activities with MEP teams/subcontractors and collaborating with consultants and developer/client representatives for inspections, approvals, RFIs, NCRs, and site instructions Ability to work full-time on construction sites, conduct regular site inspections, and participate in progress walks and coordination meetings Saudi Council of Engineers registration (or eligibility to register/transfer classification) Professional/business English proficiency Eligibility to work in Saudi Arabia Preferred Qualifications: Working proficiency with AutoCAD PMP certification Experience producing progress reports, lookahead plans, tracking delays, and implementing recovery actions on construction projects Experience in the Riyadh or Saudi market Ability to start within 30 days (notice period ≤30 days) Health insurance coverage (medical, dental, vision) Paid annual leave and public holidays On-site support and resources for project management Opportunities for advancement within a leading Saudi investment group

40af79c030faac12.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليج للتموين عن أخصائي تغذية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ برامج التغذية والحمية الغذائية لكل من المرضى والأصحاء، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتوثيق التقارير المتعلقة بالتغذية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة القيم الغذائية والسعرات الحرارية لمختلف أنواع الأغذية، وتقدير الاحتياجات الفردية من السعرات الحرارية. تحليل برامج الحمية الغذائية المتنوعة، واختيار أو إعداد برامج حمية غذائية للأفراد الأصحاء بناءً على احتياجاتهم الغذائية والحرارية. تطوير برامج تغذية للمرضى في المستشفيات، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار توصيات الطبيب المعالج والاحتياجات الغذائية للمرضى. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التغذية. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالتغذية، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال التغذية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التغذية. القدرة على وضع برامج تغذية وحمية غذائية متكاملة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير وحفظها. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالدوام الكامل. سيعمل أخصائي التغذية ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تقديم أفضل خدمات التغذية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة الخليج للتموين.

40ca1f93c274e914.description: About Almarai Almarai, a successful and expanding global business, is seeking a Stock Controller to join its team in Rabigh, Makkah. This is a full-time position offering an excellent remuneration and benefits package. Role Overview The Stock Controller is responsible for managing the movement of materials within the in-bound stores. This role focuses on ensuring efficient and effective control over all material movements to maintain operational flow. Key Responsibilities Control material movements throughout the in-bound stores. Ensure effective and efficient handling of all materials. Qualifications and Requirements High School degree is required. Must be self-motivated and dedicated to tasks. Possess a high level of computer skills. Demonstrate excellent communication skills. Ability to work effectively under pressure. Willingness to work long hours in various temperature-controlled conditions. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic environment that may require working extended hours and in conditions with varying temperatures.

40fc39f00f5301f5.description: About the Role Ninja is looking for skilled Maintenance Technicians to perform preventive and reactive maintenance across our stores and facilities. The ideal candidate will have practical experience in electrical systems, HVAC, and refrigeration, ensuring equipment reliability and smooth store operations. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and repair electrical, HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, and basic building defects. Perform scheduled preventive maintenance, inspections, cleaning, and equipment checks. Respond to urgent breakdowns and maintenance requests as scheduled. Update maintenance work orders with findings, parts used, photos, and completion details. Follow safety procedures and use approved tools and personal protective equipment (PPE). Coordinate maintenance activities with store teams and report recurring issues or warranty-related defects. Escalate complex repairs requiring specialist support or external service providers. Technical diploma or trade certificate. 3–5 years of practical maintenance experience. Working knowledge of electrical systems, HVAC, and refrigeration. Ability to perform preventive and corrective maintenance. Familiarity with mobile work orders or maintenance management systems. Strong troubleshooting skills and commitment to workplace safety

405ecae589ce8b95.job_title: IB Spanish and World Language Teacher
405ecae589ce8b95.description: About the Role ISG Jubail is seeking an IB Spanish and World Language Teacher to join their team in the Eastern region, specifically in Al Jubail or Al Khobar. This full-time role focuses on developing linguistic fluency, cultural understanding, and global awareness in students. The ideal candidate will foster intellectual curiosity, critical thinking, and meaningful communication within the framework of the IB Diploma Programme and modern language standards. Key Responsibilities Demonstrate commitment to child protection and the safety of children and young people. Embed a philosophy of learning language, learning about language, and learning through language to enhance fluency, cultural understanding, and critical thinking. Design inquiry-based experiences that connect language learning to real-world issues and interdisciplinary concepts. Plan and deliver lessons in accordance with established curriculum goals and objectives. Maintain accurate student attendance records, grades, and other required documentation. Evaluate and grade student classwork and assignments, and administer examinations. Provide additional support to students requiring assistance with coursework outside of class. Observe, monitor, and record student progress, responding to individual needs and abilities. Initiate, facilitate, and moderate classroom discussions effectively. Plan, evaluate, and revise curricula, course content, materials, and instructional methods. Stay informed of developments in the field through literature, peer collaboration, and professional conferences. Collaborate with colleagues on teaching and research matters. Contribute to academic or administrative committees addressing institutional policies and departmental issues. Supervise student after-school activities or coach/assistant coach athletic teams. Maintain a safe learning environment for students and staff. Perform other duties as assigned by the principal and/or assistant principal. Specific Responsibilities for IB Spanish / World Languages Deliver IB Spanish instruction aligned with the IBDP course guide and best practices. Support students in constructing their understanding of linguistic and cultural concepts. Create an environment that encourages student agency in language learning. Develop and foster interdisciplinary connections within language learning. Act as an advocate for high school students, learning, and programs. Contribute to the creation and revision of the language curriculum. Share interests and passions with students through after-school programs. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will understand the developmental needs of middle and high school students and actively contribute to the wider school community. This role requires a commitment to the school's mission of inspiring innovation and compassionate action, alongside a demonstrated ability to be creative in teaching approaches.

409710f9a0031d42.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المباني السريعة للمقاولات عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد المخطط، وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية. مهارات جيدة في حل المشكلات الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الهندسة الكهربائية ضمن فريق متخصص في حائل، ويقدم الدعم المباشر للمهندسين الكهربائيين لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

404a4a3363e55110.description: About the Role Egis is seeking a detail-oriented Environment Project Manager to join its site team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This contract position requires over 10 years of experience. The Project Manager will be accountable for the successful delivery of environmental services, ensuring quality, regulatory compliance, commercial performance, and client satisfaction. Role Responsibilities The Project Manager will provide leadership and oversight to Site Engineers responsible for day-to-day environmental management activities. Key responsibilities include: Reviewing, approving, and formally signing off all bi-annual environmental compliance submissions to NCEC. Reviewing and endorsing technical justifications for environmental exceedances, including air quality, noise, and other compliance-related matters, prior to submission. Approving remediation plans, corrective action reports, and closeout documentation related to NCEC violations and regulatory observations. Acting as the senior point of contact with NCEC, managing regulatory engagement and escalation matters. Leading engagement with the Client and PMCM on environmental compliance, performance, risks, and strategic matters. Allocating responsibilities among Site Engineers, establishing priorities, and defining escalation thresholds and decision-making authorities. Conducting regular progress, performance, and coordination meetings with Site Engineers, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and performance oversight. Ensuring adequate resource planning and continuity of service during absences, leave periods, or peak workload demands. Performing quality assurance reviews of environmental reports, inspection findings, audit reports, compliance submissions, and tracker updates. Ensuring the Environmental Permit Compliance Tracker and all regulatory commitment registers are accurate, complete, and maintained. Leading senior-level engagement with PMCM's environmental managers and driving resolution of persistent non-compliance issues. Establishing expectations and quality standards for overall deliverables. Managing contractual scope boundaries, timely deliverables, and invoicing. Monitoring workload, resource utilization, and deliverable frequencies against contractual assumptions. Maintaining and regularly updating the project risk register, with a focus on regulatory compliance, stakeholder management, monitoring performance, and contractor compliance risks. Providing regular reporting to the Project Director on project performance, compliance status, key risks, opportunities, and issues requiring management intervention. Ensuring robust document control, record management, and knowledge retention processes are maintained to support project continuity and audit readiness. Driving continual improvement initiatives, lessons learned, and best practices to enhance environmental performance and regulatory compliance across the project. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess the following: A minimum of 10 years of experience in environmental project management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to ensure consistent implementation of project requirements, effective stakeholder engagement, and adherence to contractual obligations. Experience in managing regulatory engagement and escalation matters. Strong understanding of environmental compliance, performance, risks, and strategic matters. Work Environment This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a contract basis. The role involves working as part of a site team, providing leadership and oversight to Site Engineers.

406375ff18e0871d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التوريدات الميكانيكيه والكيماويات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مندوب المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتعزيز قاعدة العملاء. تشمل هذه المهام جمع البيانات، التواصل مع العملاء، وإدارة عمليات البيع والتحصيل. جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات). إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. الاتصال بالعملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحية المخولة. إتمام عملية البيع، تحرير الفواتير، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية لضمان الأداء الفعال في مهام المبيعات والتواصل مع العملاء. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء وإدارة قواعد بيانات العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على التفاوض وإتمام صفقات البيع. مهارات تحصيل الديون ومتابعة الحسابات. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب هذا الدور مجموعة من المهارات الشخصية والمهنية التي تمكن مندوب المبيعات من تحقيق الأهداف المحددة والتفاعل بنجاح مع العملاء والزملاء. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة البيانات والتقارير. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات ضمن الصلاحيات الممنوحة. الالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية وتقديم التقارير بدقة. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة التوريدات الميكانيكيه والكيماويات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب طبيعة العمل زيارات ميدانية للعملاء بالإضافة إلى المهام المكتبية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة.

40657dad1fc09bb4.job_title: Vascular and Emergency Medicine Sales Product Specialist Damman EZ (eastern zone)
40657dad1fc09bb4.description: About the Role King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Center (KFSH) in Riyadh is seeking an Assistant Consultant, Vascular Surgery. This full-time position involves the diagnosis and treatment of medical diseases and conditions within the field of Vascular Surgery, ensuring the provision of medical care in accordance with established medical staff bylaws, rules, regulations, and hospital policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Assist the Consultant in providing patient care and management in Vascular Surgery, adhering to KFSH & RC medical care standards. Deliver high-quality patient care across all aspects of General Vascular Surgery, consistent with approved clinical privileges. Provide timely consultations for inpatients and emergency room cases, responding within prescribed hospital policy timeframes. Ensure timely completion, accuracy, and eligibility of medical records. Provide on-call service, ensuring availability and response within hospital policy timeframes. Conduct daily morning rounds to identify patients ready for discharge and ensure discharge orders are written 24 hours prior to discharge. Participate in educational activities, training programs, and national and international medical conferences as assigned. Provide orientation, bedside training, and supervision to interns, residents, and fellows. Engage in clinical, basic, and translational research projects in line with Research Advisory Council Policy. Undertake administrative duties assigned by the Head of Section or Chairman, including participation in departmental activities and committees. Adhere to hospital and medical staff bylaws, rules, regulations, and policies, staying updated on any changes. Qualifications and Experience Graduation from a medical school in good standing. Completion of the required period of postgraduate training in a specialty and/or subspecialty. 40665c05acb17e9e.description: About the Role BRKZ is seeking a Collection Officer to join its team in Dammam or Riyadh. This full-time role is critical for ensuring timely payments from clients by managing invoices, statements of accounts, and confirming balances. The position supports the company's financial health and client relationships. Key Responsibilities Deliver company invoices to the appropriate client division or department, ensuring all invoices and attachments are complete, accurate, and meet client-specific requirements for timely payments. Distribute monthly statements of accounts to clients and confirm accurate booking of invoices in their records. Schedule and collect payments from clients, including transfers, cheques, and cash, and follow up to ensure timely preparation and scheduling of payments. Arrange quarterly balance confirmations in coordination with clients. Dispatch bank deposit slips to the branch accountant for reconciliation and maintain accurate delivery and payment details for all transactions. Develop and sustain professional financial relationships with clients to facilitate smooth communication and conflict resolution. Assist other commercial functions to meet daily business needs. Qualifications and Experience More than 2 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within the construction environment, construction technology, or related sectors. Comprehensive knowledge of local market dynamics. Proven ability to deliver results through diligent follow-up and attention to detail. Capability to maintain professionalism while resolving challenges. Working at BRKZ This role offers an opportunity to be part of a startup where individuals can take on significant responsibility and independence. BRKZ values new ideas and maintains a product-first mindset. The compensation package includes stock options and premium health insurance.

40678cdc8bd3c42c.description: About the Role Alkhorayef Industries Company is seeking a Planning Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on demand operations and supply chain policy adherence, requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. The specialist will be responsible for developing and refining demand forecasts, optimizing supply methods, and ensuring efficient inventory management. Key Responsibilities in Demand Operations Develop demand forecasts at multiple levels of aggregation for various time horizons. Review historical sales trends, research demand drivers, prepare forecast data, develop statistical forecast models, and evaluate forecast results. Conduct cross-functional research activities to reconcile significant variances and refine the forecast model to reflect updated sales and marketing assumptions. Utilize a collaboration and consensus approach by working with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to ensure current and accurate information is used for demand forecasts. Assist in developing new or optimizing existing methods of supply, including emergency strategies, using corporate standard concepts. Perform quantitative and qualitative evaluations, considering the impact on logistics costs and structure. Investigate supply methods such as transportation, packaging, source of supply, and material flow for new or existing suppliers, as well as new supplier selection processes. Initiate, investigate, and develop medium to long-term planning strategies influencing supplier selection, and implement process improvements through innovation. Monitor warehouse inventory and communicate slow and non-moving inventory to relevant parties for immediate action. Prepare reports and statistics related to demand planning and forecasting. Use and maintain the Demand Planning Software as the primary forecasting system tool. Policy and Process Adherence Follow all relevant Supply Chain policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions to ensure work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices, considering leading practices, business process enhancement, cost reduction, and productivity improvement. Promote the implementation and adherence to policies, processes, and operating procedures within Alkhorayef Industries Company (AIC). Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant planning or supply chain role. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage demand forecasts. Experience with demand planning software and statistical forecasting models. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within Alkhorayef Industries Company. The role involves cross-functional collaboration with various departments including Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

40ab99c399580d92.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع ابن سينا برو كير الطبي عن مدير جودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يشارك شاغل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والخطط التشغيلية المتعلقة بإدارة الجودة، ويشرف على أنشطة تخطيط الجودة لضمان الكفاءة والفعالية في العمليات اليومية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تحديد الأهداف والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية لضمان معايير الجودة العالية في الجهة ووحداتها التنظيمية. متابعة تنفيذ الخطط ووضع الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لتقييم مستوى تحقيق الأهداف. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية لتحسين جودة المخرجات والخدمات، ومتابعة تنفيذها. مراجعة وتطوير أنظمة ومعايير وإجراءات ضبط وتوكيد الجودة، ونشرها وتعميمها على الوحدات التنظيمية. متابعة أحدث المستجدات في أنظمة الجودة وتقديم المقترحات لتحديث الأنظمة المعتمدة. الإشراف على إعداد التقارير والملخصات المتعلقة بمعايير الجودة وعرضها على الإدارة العليا. المهارات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة الجودة. القدرة على وضع وتطوير الخطط التشغيلية والمبادرات المتعلقة بالجودة. مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على الأنشطة وضمان توافر الموارد. القدرة على مراجعة وتطوير أنظمة ومعايير الجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لمتابعة المستجدات وتقديم المقترحات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مجمع ابن سينا برو كير الطبي في جدة، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب بيئة العمل التعاون مع فرق متعددة لضمان تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في جميع العمليات والخدمات. المؤهلات يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات اللازمة للمشاركة بفعالية في وضع وتنفيذ استراتيجيات الجودة، مع القدرة على الإشراف على العمليات وضمان الامتثال للمعايير المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

40dc09e6c47b171b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدلتا السعوديه للصناعات الكيماويه عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، متابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل القيود المالية لضمان دقة السجلات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المهام اليومية يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. كما يشمل الدور إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. يتطلب الدور أيضاً إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتدقيق المستندات والتقارير المالية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإجراءاتها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التشغيلية لشركة الدلتا السعوديه للصناعات الكيماويه. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور. يمكن للمرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه تقديم طلباتهم.

407afb78f35f9d4d.job_title: Assistant Director of People and Culture
407afb78f35f9d4d.description: About the Role Earth Hotels is seeking a People & Culture Manager to lead the pre-opening People journey for its Riyadh location. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on building a workplace culture centered on experiences, community, wellness, creativity, and connection. The manager will be responsible for establishing the People & Culture framework from the ground up, ensuring a positive employee experience from recruitment through daily operations. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the People & Culture pre-opening plan, aligning with the hotel opening timeline and budget. Create the hotel manning guide and organization chart, including headcount, grades, salary scales, and Saudization targets. Lead the phased recruitment drive for all hotel positions, from executive committee to line-level teams, ensuring timely staffing for training. Manage new joiner mobilization, including visa quotas, work permits, arrivals, employee accommodation, and transport. Establish People foundations such as policies, procedures, HRIS, trackers, and employee files. Deliver opening induction and culture immersion programs for all new employees. Build talent pipelines with local educational institutions and community partners, focusing on Saudization and Nitaqat compliance. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, entrepreneurial, and accountable culture within the hotel. Plan and deliver employee engagement activities, internal communication, recognition, and culture initiatives. Lead the resolution of employee relations matters, including grievances and disciplinary cases, with discretion. Oversee onboarding, learning, and development programs to build capability and support career growth. Drive performance management processes and ensure strong succession planning and talent development. Ensure full compliance with Saudi Labor Law, MHRSD regulations, and internal People procedures. Administer compensation, rewards, and benefits programs, ensuring fairness and compliance. Oversee attendance, leave, scheduling, and monthly payroll inputs, partnering with Finance for accurate processing. Recruit, lead, and develop the hotel’s People & Culture team, setting clear priorities and service standards. Act as an active member of the hotel leadership team and manage the People & Culture department budget. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in People & Culture or Human Resources. Demonstrated experience in pre-opening phases for hotels or similar establishments is highly preferred. Strong understanding of Saudi Labor Law and MHRSD regulations. Proven ability to build and lead a team. Experience in developing and implementing HR policies and procedures from scratch. Required Skills Excellent leadership and team development skills. Strong communication and interpersonal abilities. Proficiency in HRIS and data management. Strategic planning and execution capabilities. Problem-solving and conflict resolution skills. Commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 40da112bab17cc29.description: About Coastal Transportation Services Company Coastal Transportation Services Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, provides transportation services at the Red Sea destination. As part of the Red Sea Global Group, the company benefits from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives, enhancing its ability to serve clients effectively. The company focuses on innovation and sustainable transportation solutions, including cutting-edge projects such as autonomous vehicles. Role Overview The Manager - Fleet Maintenance is responsible for overseeing the maintenance and operational readiness of the bus fleet under contract in Riyadh. This full-time role ensures that all relevant fleet vehicles are maintained in optimal condition, with scheduled servicing and preventive maintenance (PM) completed on time. The incumbent will audit and manage contractor performance to ensure fleet availability, reliability, and compliance with company standards. Key Responsibilities Oversee and manage maintenance contracts with service providers, ensuring all terms and conditions are met and addressing performance issues. Ensure maximum fleet availability by monitoring service schedules, downtime, and repairs, working proactively to minimize disruptions. Conduct regular audits of contractor maintenance activities to ensure adherence to industry standards, safety regulations, and contractual obligations. Ensure all relevant fleet vehicles undergo regular servicing, preventive maintenance (PM), and necessary repairs according to manufacturer guidelines and company policies. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to fleet maintenance, including uptime, service completion rates, and contractor efficiency. Monitor maintenance costs and optimize expenses through efficient resource allocation and identification of cost-saving opportunities. Liaise with operations, procurement, and finance teams to ensure smooth execution of maintenance activities and budget adherence. Ensure all buses comply with safety regulations, environmental guidelines, and operational standards set by Red Sea Global. Prepare and present periodic reports on fleet maintenance status, contractor performance, and critical issues. Identify opportunities for improving maintenance efficiency, reducing downtime, and enhancing overall fleet reliability. Follow all relevant functional policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Apply safety, quality, and environmental management policies and procedures. Contribute to the continuous improvement of department systems, processes, and practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in fleet maintenance management. Demonstrated experience in contract management and auditing service provider performance. Proficiency in monitoring KPIs and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. Strong understanding of safety regulations and environmental guidelines in fleet operations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role operates within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, requiring collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders to achieve operational excellence in transportation services.

402cd0d8704d8d16.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. يتطلب هذا الدور سائقًا ملتزمًا ومسؤولًا لضمان النقل الآمن والفعال، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والسلامة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة بمسؤولية وضمان الالتزام بمواعيد النقل المحددة. التبليغ الفوري عن أي تأخير اضطراري قد يحدث أثناء القيادة. الالتزام التام بجميع قواعد المرور وأنظمة الأمن والسلامة على الطرق. التنبه الشديد لتجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية أو مرورية. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة على السيارة للتأكد من جاهزيتها وسلامتها. معالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ على السيارة أثناء الاستخدام. رفع طلبات الصيانة المتخصصة عند ملاحظة أي خلل يتطلب فحص الخبراء. الالتزام الصارم بالأدلة الإجرائية، أدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية كسائق سيارة خاص تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للسيارة والتعامل مع المشكلات البسيطة. بيئة العمل يعمل السائق ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمواعيد والمسؤوليات المحددة لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: عسير المدينة: أبها الراتب: غير معلن

4091f4c3d15286f3.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Foreman Structural Fitter to join their team in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region. The role holder will ensure adherence to applicable technical specifications, company policies, procedures, and work instructions, while also focusing on continuous improvement in flat block assembly productivity. Key Responsibilities Ensure all assigned works are executed safely and on schedule. Verify that all technical drawings and documentation are strictly followed. 40a9ecbf178403e4.description: About Tronox Tronox is a global leader in the manufacturing of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment and other materials that enhance the brightness and durability of everyday products. With a workforce of 5,700 individuals across six continents, Tronox is guided by strong values. The company is dedicated to responsibly transforming earth's resources into products and opportunities, with a vision to foster a sustainable world through refined minerals. Role Summary The Shift Operator L is responsible for ensuring Safe Quality Low Cost Sustainable Tons (SQLCST) at their assigned post or workstation. This full-time position, located in Yanbu, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, involves performing a variety of activities across multiple areas using complex equipment. The role requires continuous monitoring of operations to maintain product quality and inventory, along with providing coaching and guidance to develop technical expertise within the company. This role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Monitor and adjust process parameters to maintain safe and optimal conditions, ensuring smooth and stable operations. Prepare equipment for maintenance procedures. Accurately and promptly enter data into the shift logsheet, logbook, and Control Room system (*, SIC). Perform thorough and timely plant rounds to identify issues with plant/equipment and ensure safe, stable operations. Raise maintenance job requests in the system as applicable. Detect and report process deviations promptly, utilizing A3 investigation for process problems. Participate in incident investigations. Utilize IT systems for reporting and data gathering. Strictly follow and perform all normal and emergency start-up and shutdown tasks according to approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure safe, stable, and error-free operations. Ensure all shift handover requirements are well-detailed, easy to understand, and maintain continuity of plant/process performance. Operate plant/equipment without guidance (*, field, localized DCS).
